source-custody/evidence records traceable to that acquisition

source_access.consequence: Do not populate source-question rows from prior art or mathematical plausibility.
source_access.next_valid_input: registered-source readback of the first 11 PDF pages or owner-provided source attachment/bytes bound to the same acquisition digest

ledger.stable_identity_rule: Use source page + readable source label/type; if source label is absent or unreadable, use a deterministic page-local sequence id without inventing a printed question number.
ledger.printed_page_rule: UNKNOWN while scan manifest page_map is null.

answer_custody.invariant: A source final answer is not source reasoning; independent derivation must remain explicitly authored/verification analysis.

uncertainty.numeric_and_equation_rule: Require an independent second reading from the page image by a different reader before promotion of numeric/equation-sensitive scan evidence.
uncertainty.unresolved_rule: Do not guess. A material unresolved reading blocks final mathematical classification and Explorer/Clinic selection for that item.

levels.C2: multiple concepts or an implicit invariant must be connected

levels.R3: choosing/building the right representation is itself decisive

levels.M2: multiple plausible routes or a significant trap
levels.M3: discovering/selecting the route is the central difficulty

levels.A3: unusually long bookkeeping, branching, or constraint propagation

algebraic_length.invariant: A3 alone does not make a question mathematically Hard.

levels.S2: material ambiguity resolved through independent readback

source_scan.invariant: S never contributes to mathematical hardness. S3 blocks final selection judgement.

overall_labels.EASY: C/R/M all <=1 with a direct standard route; no hidden dependent reasoning chain.
overall_labels.MEDIUM: At least one genuine level-2 mathematical demand, but no decisive C3/R3/M3 bottleneck; unusually long standard algebra may remain Medium.
overall_labels.HARD: C3, R3, or M3; or multiple interacting C2/R2/M2 demands forming a dependent reasoning chain.

tests: manipulation varies a mathematically meaningful object or parameter
interaction reveals an invariant, dependency, boundary, structural special case, or representation relationship
static examples would communicate materially less well
the structure explains a real in-scope reasoning bottleneck
the learner can follow predict → manipulate → observe → explain → formalise → apply

priority_order: plausible wrong route and diagnostic value
algebraic length as secondary evidence only
exclusions: routine questions that are merely long
